how: Squeeze both fists as hard as you can and hold, then let the hands spring open and soften. Feel the release flow through the hands and arms. Repeat a few times.
name: Fist Squeeze & Release
notes: RESEARCH: confirm the source. Possibly Yi Jin Jing (易筋经, Tendon-Changing Classic, tension-and-release postures) or Wo Gu (握固, 'holding firm', thumb tucked inside the fist). Related: Ba Duan Jin #7, 'Clench the fists and glare the eyes'.
